línea no reconocida: deadline 31 Jan 1953. 45 teams entered, 39 seeded, 36 actually played.

línea no reconocida: drawn 21 Jun 1954. Semifinals drawn 27 Jun 1954. All draws in Zürich.
línea no reconocida: General Note : The placement in groups was determined solely on
línea no reconocida: the base of points, goal difference was disregarded. This led to playoff
línea no reconocida: matches in two groups (curiosly, teams with worse g/d won).
línea no reconocida: Matches were extended by an extra-time whenever there happened to be a
línea no reconocida: draw after normal time. If the draw persisted after the extra time,
